title: Source/program/object provenance binding for hinge comparison
intent: Establish whether source and artifact object-provenance inputs belong together before comparing hinge fields.

requirements.description: Use exact independently bound source and artifact inputs.
requirements.acceptance: Accept supplied main.ok/hinges.ok and GLB bytes through pinned C265/C261 and only permitted C257 lexical/module/occurrence utilities; no product parser, evaluator, exporter or ownership/follow comparator.

requirements.description: Bind canonical source/program claims and complete object identities.
requirements.acceptance: Reconcile exact source hashes/import pins, canonical manifest/revision, entry identities, full source-unit map, complete object ID/path sets, class names and node program revisions against source.

requirements.description: Verify all retained repeated object provenance.
requirements.acceptance: Independently derive both source_mapping and program_occurrence: exact declaration/definition spans, path steps, root/owner paths, declaration definition IDs, generated collection/key/input/full input-entry witnesses and generated ancestry; reject sparse, stale, contradictory or wrongly typed claims.

requirements.description: Support changed inputs and preserve bounded refusals.
requirements.acceptance: Support correctly rebound changed source names/keys/membership/byte offsets, direct/helper/final overridden keyed inputs, opaque punctuation keys and node reordering. Preserve inherited resource limits and typed whole-input refusals with bounded available hashes/byte counts.

requirements.description: Keep the prerequisite distinct from hinge comparison.
requirements.acceptance: Return only input association and bound objects, no qualified hinge set. Hinge values, ordered endpoints and complete joint-set comparison remain unqualified; historical/pose/validity/revision/execution claims remain false. Top-level module/scene and program collections omitted by the C261 public excerpt remain explicitly unobserved.

requirements.description: Verify and independently review the exact increment.
requirements.acceptance: Independent public-API controls cover adversarial repeated claims, changed inputs and nonclaims; complete relevant predecessor/component cohorts and workflow/documentation checks pass with exact input identities. Preserve failures and partial H-group mapping.

requirements.description: Integrate and verify main and completed branch disposition.
requirements.acceptance: Acquire verified bounded lease, expected-head PR merge, read actual merge/main, rerun applicable checks, retain branch ancestry and verify deletion or record exact deletion_pending.

requirements.description: Verify and save the required online session handoff.
requirements.acceptance: Required root files, prompts, frozen Git read-set, unique recovery payloads and manifest pass exact ZIP/fresh extraction; confirmed saved OntoKin-folder identity is recorded externally before completion. C262 remains unchanged. Stop.
